تستفرغن (form X)
# تَسْتَفْرِغْنَ (tastafriḡna) /tas.taf.riɣ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَفْرَغَ (istafraḡa)
# تُسْتَفْرَغْنَ (tustafraḡna) /tus.taf.raɣ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَفْرَغَ (istafraḡa)
